title: Quantize, Qualify, Rerank: A Recipe for Compressing LLMs Without Losing Quality
abstract: arXiv:2611.18587v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compressing large language models lowers serving cost, but a single automatic metric may miss quality loss. For the WMT26 Model Compression constrained track, we compress google/gemma-3-12b-it (24.4 GB in bf16) for three translation directions on one H100. Paired bootstrap analysis exposes metric disagreement on 4-bit quantization; guided by WMT24 human meta-evaluation, we use MetricX24-XXL as primary and CometKiwi-XXL as a cross-check. Removing the unused vision stack and non-task vocabulary and using int8 weights or fp8 activations causes no resolved loss, whereas int4 leaves a small residual. QLoRA healing overfits its calibration domain. A Cometoid best-of-4 reranker at $T=0.3$ improves both the 8-bit and 4-bit systems under WMT25 test set. On post-submission WMT26, both remain competitive with bf16 under reference-free metrics; the small difference between the reranked variants is treated as noise.

translated_title: 量化、评估、重排：一种在不损失质量的前提下压缩大语言模型的方法
translated_abstract: 压缩大语言模型可以降低服务成本，但单一的自动评估指标可能会遗漏质量损失。针对WMT26模型压缩受限赛道，我们在一块H100上为三个翻译方向压缩了google/gemma-3-12b-it模型（bf16格式下为24.4 GB）。配对自助法分析揭示了4-bit量化时各评估指标间的分歧；在WMT24人工元评估的指导下，我们采用MetricX24-XXL作为主要指标，CometKiwi-XXL作为交叉验证。实验表明，移除未使用的视觉模块和非任务词汇表，并使用int8权重或fp8激活不会造成可解析的质量损失，而int4量化则会留下少量残余损失。QLoRA修复会过拟合其校准域。在温度T=0.3下的Cometoid best-of-4重排器在WMT25测试集上同时提升了8-bit和4-bit系统的表现。在提交后的WMT26评测中，两者在无参考指标下仍与bf16基线保持竞争力；重排变体之间的微小差异被视为噪声。
tldr: 该论文提出“量化-评估-重排”三步压缩方案，通过配对自助法多指标评估（MetricX24-XXL为主、CometKiwi-XXL交叉验证）结合Cometoid best-of-4重排技术，成功将Gemma-3-12b-it压缩至8-bit/4-bit精度且在机器翻译任务中不损失质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a quantize-qualify-rerank compression recipe, using paired bootstrap metric analysis (MetricX24-XXL as primary, CometKiwi-XXL as cross-check) combined with a Cometoid best-of-4 reranker to compress Gemma-3-12b-it to 8-bit/4-bit precision without sacrificing translation quality.
